question.text: Trustees are required to report transactions in securities exceeding what value to the Mutual Fund?

explanation.text: The Logic: Trustees are required to report to the Mutual Fund only those transactions in securities that exceed Rs 5 lakhs in value (NISM-Series-III-C workbook, p.258). The Trap: Rs 1 lakh is the reporting threshold for directors of the AMC, which is lower than the trustee threshold (p.258). Note: Remember the source-backed contrast between the Rs 5 lakhs trustee threshold and the Rs 1 lakh AMC director threshold from p.258.
